# Forecast

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `DETERMINISTIC-MATH` `TIE-CHECKED` `EVIDENCE-GATED` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `POLICY-CAPTURING` `AUDIT-TRAIL`

A rolling forecast where actual months are locked and every forecast line names its driver — run-rate, growth, contract, seasonal, or manual with a stated reason. Assumption changes are logged as decision records.

## Why these badges

- **`TIE-CHECKED`** — Actual columns tie to the P&amp;L export, and every forecast cell traces to a driver in FORECAST.md — no orphan numbers.
- **`EVIDENCE-GATED`** — Never forecasts a month that has actuals; says so plainly if the latest month isn't closed.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ledger.pnl-by-month` | **yes** | integration manifest | P&amp;L by month export |
| `ar.open-invoices` | no | integration manifest | skip booked-revenue grounding |
| `ledger.gl-detail` | no | integration manifest | ask about run-rate anomalies |
| `forecast.csv + FORECAST.md` | no | client workspace | created on first run |
| `REPORT-PREFS.md` | no | client workspace | ask once |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| forecast.csv | csv | client workspace — account × month, actuals locked, forecast computed |
| FORECAST.md | markdown | client workspace — the driver behind every line |
| change diff | chat | what moved since the last forecast and why |
| headline | chat | full-year landing vs budget and vs last forecast, with the three changes that moved it most |
| decision records | markdown (ADR) | docs/decisions/ — for hard-to-reverse assumption changes |

## What it will not do

- Overwrite an actual month with a forecast.
